knownLimitations.summary: Aircraft and platform compatibility is demonstrated only with software fixtures and simulated unarmed ISR/support scenarios; no aircraft installation is qualified.
knownLimitations.degradedDataProcedure: Keep the release in controlled non-operational evaluation and do not authorize aircraft dispatch or maintenance release from its output.
knownLimitations.requiredHumanAction: Approve the exact platform configuration and complete representative hardware-in-the-loop and aircraft-interface acceptance.

knownLimitations.summary: Institutionally approved terrain and obstacle coverage is not bundled or accepted.
knownLimitations.degradedDataProcedure: Treat geographic displays as planning context and prohibit terrain- or obstacle-dependent release decisions.
knownLimitations.requiredHumanAction: Ingest signed official packages and complete qualified provenance, coverage, resolution, datum, currency, and boundary validation.

knownLimitations.summary: Official map, AIP, and NOTAM acquisition, currency, reconciliation, and expiry controls are not institutionally accepted.
knownLimitations.degradedDataProcedure: Missing, expired, stale, out-of-coverage, or unverifiable critical data blocks the affected dispatch or decision; no automatic override is permitted.
knownLimitations.requiredHumanAction: Approve the official-data lifecycle or use the documented controlled exception with delegated authority, alternate official evidence, residual-risk decision, conditions, exact scope, expiry, and human signatures.
knownLimitations.controlledExceptionProcess: A delegated authority may authorize only a time-bounded, scope-bounded exception after a qualified reviewer hashes alternate official evidence and the risk authority records residual risk, compensating controls, stop criteria, monitoring, conditions, and expiry. The data defect and exception remain conspicuous.

knownLimitations.summary: Telemetry field completeness, units, timing, provenance, and failure behavior are not qualified against a representative aircraft source.
knownLimitations.degradedDataProcedure: Enter the documented unknown/degraded state for stale, malformed, missing, or conflicting fields and prohibit flight-critical reliance.
knownLimitations.requiredHumanAction: Complete and sign representative adapter, fault-injection, timing, provenance, and hardware-in-the-loop validation.

knownLimitations.summary: The implemented profile is limited to Colombian state-aviation unarmed ISR/support safety monitoring; weapons, strike, autonomous flight, swarm control, and aircraft command-and-control are outside scope.
knownLimitations.degradedDataProcedure: Block out-of-profile use and keep all command-and-control paths absent.
knownLimitations.requiredHumanAction: Design, verify, and institutionally accept a separate profile before any scope expansion.

knownLimitations.summary: English translations and software summaries have not received final qualified bilingual legal review.
knownLimitations.degradedDataProcedure: Use the official Spanish source as controlling and prohibit final regulatory determinations based only on English assistance.
knownLimitations.requiredHumanAction: Complete the controlled translation crosswalk and obtain qualified FAC regulatory and bilingual legal signatures.

knownLimitations.summary: Research workflows use synthetic or deidentified evidence and are not approved for human-subject or operational decision use.
knownLimitations.degradedDataProcedure: Keep research data segregated, access-controlled, and non-dispatchable; do not use exploratory outputs for operational decisions.
knownLimitations.requiredHumanAction: Obtain protocol or ethics, privacy, data-governance, retention, export, and participant-protection approval before real participant use.

knownLimitations.summary: Automated accessibility tests do not constitute representative operational usability acceptance.
knownLimitations.degradedDataProcedure: Limit use to evaluation and retain independent human verification for every safety-relevant interpretation.
knownLimitations.requiredHumanAction: Complete the approved human-factors protocol with representative users, receiving hardware, environments, workload, and recovery tasks.

knownLimitations.summary: Repository security checks do not replace receiving-site approved scanning, penetration testing, key custody, encryption, and deployment attestation.
knownLimitations.degradedDataProcedure: Keep the bundle off operational networks and use only controlled development or evaluation infrastructure.
knownLimitations.requiredHumanAction: Complete institutional cybersecurity and receiving-node deployment review for the exact release and evidence hashes.

knownLimitations.summary: Multi-aircraft and accelerated 12-hour tests are synthetic and are not wall-clock soak or representative hardware-in-the-loop qualification.
knownLimitations.degradedDataProcedure: Limit concurrency and duration to controlled evaluation with monitoring and a manual stop/recovery procedure.
knownLimitations.requiredHumanAction: Complete and accept receiving-hardware load, fault-recovery, endurance, and wall-clock soak evidence.
